name: blitz
description: Language-agnostic agentic development loop: research, plan, build, check, ship. Plans are JSON task DAGs with per-task verify commands; a task is done only when scripts/tasks.sh verified it and a hook denies every other write. One fresh-context dev agent per task, opt-in parallel worktree waves, an adversarial read-only critic before PASS, a shared check registry, anti-shortcut hooks, a diagnostic ratchet that works in any language, and next --loop for unattended ticks. Requires Claude Code >=2.1.271.

lsp_typescript.title: TypeScript language server
lsp_typescript.description: Binary for .ts/.tsx/.js code intelligence. Install: npm i -g typescript-language-server typescript. Clear this field to let another plugin's TypeScript server win.

lsp_python.title: Python language server
lsp_python.description: Binary for .py code intelligence. Install: pip install pyright (provides pyright-langserver). Clear this field to opt out.

lsp_rust.title: Rust language server
lsp_rust.description: Binary for .rs code intelligence. Install rust-analyzer via rustup component add rust-analyzer. Clear this field to opt out.

lsp_go.title: Go language server
lsp_go.description: Binary for .go code intelligence. Install: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest. Clear this field to opt out.
